items.title: US disrupts North Korean campaign behind $400 million crypto theft
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>The U.S. government has disrupted a North Korean social engineering campaign called 'FaceStealer', responsible for stealing more than $400 million in cryptocurrency. [...]</article>

items.title: Trezor confirms crypto-stealing implants in three wallets, releases fix
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>Cryptocurrency hardware wallet maker Trezor has confirmed that three Safe 5 devices sold by Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis contained malicious hardware implants designed to steal wallet recovery phrases and send them to attackers over cellular networks. [...]</article>

items.title: German military drone operations disrupted by cyberattack
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>German defense technology company Quantum Systems confirmed that it detected an incident in late October that was part of an active cyberattack by "hostile actors." [...]</article>

items.title: Check Point gateways hacked via PHP2Shell to deploy VMware ESXi wiper
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>Vulnerable Check Point Security Gateway instances have been targeted in PHP2Shell attacks that deployed data-wiping malware on VMware ESXi hosts. [...]</article>

items.title: How one AI agent exposed five critical enterprise security gaps
items.author: Sponsored by Token Security
items.content: <article>An AI agent built to automate invoice processing could be manipulated into changing vendor bank details through a malicious email, without triggering traditional security alerts. Token Security examines five critical AI agent security gaps and shares practical guidance from industry security leaders on preventing them. [...]</article>

items.title: Microsoft says November security updates cause printing issues
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Microsoft warned customers earlier this week that the November 2026 security updates may break printing for documents with complex formatting. [...]</article>

items.title: Check Point warns of zero-day flaw exploited for root access
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Check Point Software has released emergency hotfixes to address a high-severity flaw that hackers have been exploiting to gain root privileges and establish persistence on vulnerable devices since late October. [...]</article>

items.title: Microsoft confirms Windows activation failures after November updates
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Microsoft has confirmed that this month's Patch Tuesday security updates are causing Windows activation and licensing failures with 0x80041008 error codes. [...]</article>

items.title: Police arrest 354 suspects in dark web cybercrime crackdown
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Authorities arrested 354 suspects in a joint international operation targeting vendors and buyers on the Archetyp, Nemesis, Tor2Door, Bohemia, and Kingdom dark web marketplaces. [...]</article>

items.title: New worm-like 'SCKit' malware targets MSPs in ScreenConnect attacks
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>A new worm-like malware toolkit named SCKit was deployed in the recent ScreenConnect attacks targeting managed service providers (MSPs), designed to spread from infected customer devices to MSP technicians' computers and compromise additional managed networks. [...]</article>

items.title: Hackers compromise 4,800 GitHub accounts to steal cloud credentials
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>A new campaign dubbed 'wfx-loot' has unfolded on GitHub where threat actors used 4,837 compromised accounts to probe 61,764 repositories, open pull requests, and push secrets-stealing malware. [...]</article>

items.title: Massive Microsoft 365 outage disrupts Outlook, Teams, Copilot worldwide
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>Microsoft is investigating a widespread outage affecting multiple Microsoft 365 services, including Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and Copilot, as users report connectivity problems worldwide. [...]</article>

items.title: New N-able "4EverAble2Shell" zero-day exploited hours after PoC released
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>Hackers are actively exploiting a newly disclosed N-able N-central zero-day vulnerability dubbed "4EverAble2Shell" to compromise servers and deploy cryptocurrency miners, with researchers reporting at least 21 affected systems, including 19 running the company's latest security update. [...]</article>

items.title: Apache HTTP Server patches critical HTTP/2 remote code execution flaw
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>A critical vulnerability in the HTTP/2 module of Apache HTTP Server could be exploited by an unauthenticated attacker to obtain remote code execution (RCE). [...]</article>

items.title: New Windows SignDrop zero-day gives hackers SYSTEM privileges
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Security researcher Abdelhamid Naceri (also known as Nightmare Eclipse) has released a new Windows zero-day exploit that can let attackers gain SYSTEM privileges. [...]</article>
